# TScrapingBot Overview

## Home (https://tscrapingbot-web.vercel.app)

TScrapingBot is a Telegram bot that analyzes web pages using AI. Users send a URL and receive summaries, answers and more generated by AI.

## Features (https://tscrapingbot-web.vercel.app/features)
- Text Generation and Answers: Produces AI-powered text responses and maintains fluid conversations.
- Web Content Analysis: Processes URLs to extract summaries, search for specific information and answer questions based on page content.
- Reasoning Mode: Offers deep processing for elaborate and contextualized answers.
- Conventional Memory: Keeps chat context over time, ensuring consistent interactions.

## Technologies (https://tscrapingbot-web.vercel.app/stack)
- Original language: Python.
- Current implementation: Rust, for better performance.
- Future updates may incorporate new technologies for greater efficiency.


## Usage (https://tscrapingbot-web.vercel.app/use)
- Scan the QR code to launch the bot on Telegram or press the provided button for immediate access.
